Description.en-US:
Adds a Repair submenu to the game's own Q context menu, so you pick which module to fix instead of repairing everything at once: engine, transmission, radiator, left track, right track. Each entry shows its own cost in seconds and the five together add up to the 30 s budget (engine 8, transmission 8, radiator 4, each track 5); RepairSeconds = 0 repairs instantly.

While the timer runs the module's health climbs linearly and a line at the bottom of the screen counts down; clicking the entry again cancels and keeps the health recovered so far. When the timer finishes the mod clears the game's internal damage flags, restarts the engine, restores the transmission type it had before it was killed, re-enables power and the turret platforms, and only drops the chassis broken flag and the parking brake once the engine and both tracks are healthy again - so repairing just the radiator cannot turn a crippled vehicle into a drivable one.

It repairs nothing you would not expect: no dents, no crew, no ammo.

Requires MelonLoader. Tested against game version 0.1.0-alpha+20261014.

Note: the Repair Kit mod (J key, hold to repair) covers the same ground. The two have never been tested together, so this entry deliberately declares no conflict - if both are installed, keep only one switched on.
Description.zh-CN:
在游戏原生 Q 键上下文菜单里加入 Repair 子菜单，自己点要修哪个模块，而不是一次全修：发动机、变速箱、散热器、左履带、右履带。每个菜单项标着自己的耗时，五项合计 30 秒（发动机 8、变速箱 8、散热器 4、每条履带 5）；RepairSeconds 设为 0 就是立刻修完。

读条期间该模块血量线性回升，屏幕底部显示剩余秒数，再次点击可取消并保留已修好的部分。倒计时结束后才清游戏内部的损坏标志、重启发动机、恢复被弄坏之前的变速箱挡位类型、重新供电并点亮炮塔平台；只有发动机和两条履带最终都健康时才会解除底盘 broken 标志与手刹——所以只修散热器不会把瘫痪的车变成能开的。

不修外观凹陷、不复活乘员、不加弹药。

需要 MelonLoader。在 0.1.0-alpha+20261014 版本实测。

说明：Repair Kit（按 J 键读条维修）与本模组功能重叠，两者共存从未验证过，因此本条目刻意不声明冲突；如果两个都装了，请只保留一个开启。

Description.en-US:
Burning hulks cost frames, so once the field holds enough of them this mod clears them. It watches the vehicles the game itself counts as lost - its own neutralized flag, the same one the casualty report and the tactical map read - and as soon as WreckThreshold (default 3) of them are on the field, every wreck that has already been burning for WreckDelay (default 8 s) is cleared in one pass. Below the threshold nothing is touched: it is a threshold, not a trickle. F8 switches the cleanup on and off during a mission.

Wrecks are hidden with SetActive(false) and the game's own hide-on-map flag, never Destroy'd. Destroying them would leave the game's unit list and AI target references pointing at dead objects and throw MissingReferenceException, because SceneUnitsManager only rebuilds its list when it is empty; hiding keeps every reference valid and the next sweep naturally drops the unit.

Everything this mod hid is shown again while the game plays its own after action report - that replay films the vehicles it lost - and cleaned again afterwards.

Only ground and air vehicles are handled; infantry, emplacements and your own vehicle are skipped. Nothing is repaired or respawned.

Requires MelonLoader. Tested against game version 0.1.0-alpha+20261014.
Description.zh-CN:
燃烧的残骸很吃帧，所以场上残骸一多本模组就清场。它盯着游戏自己判定为已损失的载具（就是伤亡统计与战术地图读的那个 neutralized 标志），一旦场上达到 WreckThreshold（默认 3）辆，就把所有已燃烧超过 WreckDelay（默认 8 秒）的残骸一次性清掉；不到阈值完全不动——是「到数就清场」而不是逐个慢慢消失。F8 可在任务中随时开关。

残骸是用 SetActive(false) 加上游戏自己的隐藏标志处理的，绝不 Destroy：销毁会让游戏的单位列表与 AI 目标引用指向失效对象并抛 MissingReferenceException（SceneUnitsManager 只在列表为空时才重建），隐藏则让所有引用继续有效，下一轮扫描自然排除。

游戏播放自己的战后报告期间，本模组隐藏过的一切都会还原（那段回放要拍到这些车），报告结束后再清。

只处理地面与空中载具，跳过步兵、固定工事与玩家当前座车；不修复、不复活任何东西。

需要 MelonLoader。在 0.1.0-alpha+20261014 版本实测。
